record_bound.calculation: 6 * (16384 + 1) + 128 = 98438. Fixed UTC stdout/stderr JSON fields are <=69B; 128B allowance is conservative.

record_bound.encoding_proof: jsonlogbytes.go64-140: ASCII control/<>& =>6 bytes; quote/backslash/newline/CR=>2; invalid UTF8 one-byte error =>6 (\ufffd); U+2028/U+2029 three input bytes=>6; other UTF8 <=input bytes. <=6x for every byte. marshalMessage outputs only Log/Stream/Created/RawAttrs; PLogMetaData not encoded. UTC timestamp<=32 bytes including quotes, stdout/stderr6 bytes, fixed JSON overhead<=69B; conservative128B.

rotation.unit_qualification: FromHumanSize uses decimalMap; m = 1000*1000, not MiB. Using 16MiB would be conservative.
rotation.calculation: Each write starts below capacity, adds <=98438B; bound C-1+B. Two named files <=2*(16000000-1+98438).
rotation.transient_named_copy: None in successful uncompressed rotation: unlink oldest .1, rename current to .1, open empty current. Rotation/write serialization uses w.mu/rotateMu; no compression goroutine.
rotation.failed_rotation: Writer attempts truncating current even if rotation unlink/rename failed; ordinary initial-empty/source-controlled premise remains required.

physical_bound_missing_premises: Actual selected/running daemon must bind to this distro implementation.

Bound daemon and external readers that retain unlinked file descriptions, or establish no readers during growth plus positive retirement. ReadLogs opens current plus rotated files and defers close; there is no source-wide bound on independent readers. A named-file bound alone is not a physical bound.

Bind filesystem allocation/preallocation/delayed-free/metadata behavior and full growth accounting for retained blocks. Source logical size alone does not establish st_blocks/transient physical storage upper bound.
Bind effective source path/config and no unrelated writers/extra files for this container log directory.
owner_observation: Prepared owner invokes logs after normal exited state, or after stop/kill in cleanup. This helps but by itself does not bound independent readers or prove no logging/drain overlap after exit.
96MiB_decision: Named-file logical payload fits 96MiB by a wide margin; 96MiB total physical ceiling is NOT PROVED by this source inspection.

actions.first_fetch_failure: fetch-dsc-1.json: HTTP404 incorrect binary-name source path; source package metadata correction then fetched exact docker.io-app source. No service/auth/policy error encountered.

next_executable_observation: Read-only actual daemon executable/package binding and bounded-reader/filesystem allocation evidence, under separately authorized scope. No admission or execution release supplied.
conditional_96MiB_feasibility: Let P=16098437B per file. If exactly two named files plus at most K distinct retained unlinked log inodes exist, payload <=(2+K)*P. K<=4 gives96590622B, leaving4072674B within96MiB for all allocation/metadata/transient overhead. K<=2 gives64393748B, leaving36269548B. These are sufficient arithmetic conditions, NOT established reader/allocation premises; unbounded independent readers defeat any fixed max-file physical cap.
